channel.title: Wire — DevOps
channel.description: DevOps from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Kubernetes Changed Block Tracking API - Beta Differences
item.description: Changed Block Tracking (CBT) support for CSI drivers shipped as Alpha in September 2025. With the March 2026 v1.0.0 release of the external-snapshot-metadata project, the feature moved to Beta . (1 source: kubernetesblog)

item.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Memory QoS Graduates to Beta
item.description: Memory QoS has graduated to Beta in Kubernetes v1.37 and is now enabled by default. On Linux nodes running cgroup v2, the feature uses the memory controller to give the kernel better guidance on how to treat container memory. (1 source: kubernetesblog)

item.title: Grab's Agent Framework LLM-Kit Accelerates AI Agent Production Deployment
item.description: Grab has implemented LLM-Kit, a framework that standardizes over 500 internal agent services. This system enhances service integration, evaluation, and secret handling, reducing the time to deploy new AI agents from two weeks to one hour. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: How Solaris' Turnstile Influenced the Modern System Designs of Web Browsers and Language Runtimes
item.description: Sun's Solaris influenced modern systems engineering, with key innovations like the Slab Allocator for efficient memory management, OpenZFS for advanced storage, and DTrace for observability. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Tough days at GitHub, a continuing series
item.description: It wasn’t even a week ago when I wrote about a major GitHub incident. Yesterday, they had another big incident, which lasted almost eight hours. There’s a public write-up already posted… (1 source: sreweekly)

item.title: How senior leaders disrupt incidents just by showing up
item.description: A senior leader who joins an incident channel and says nothing still changes the room. The disruption isn't caused by anything they do. It's caused by what they are. (1 source: sreweekly)

item.title: How Lowe’s SRE Team is Driving Reliability Through Hyper Automation and Unified Platforms
item.description: Learn how Lowe's SRE team maximizes system reliability and operational efficiency, enhancing customer experience and performance in online retail. (1 source: sreweekly)

item.title: Before You Automate a Decision, Define Its Blast Radius
item.description: Before automating a business decision, assess its blast radius across scope, detection, reversibility, and downstream dependencies to contain failures early. (1 source: sreweekly)

item.title: Managing Kubernetes node drains with Pod Disruption Budgets
item.description: A missing PodDisruptionBudget lets a routine node drain take your service offline. Learn how to set minAvailable, find gaps, and test that your PDB holds. (1 source: sreweekly)
